# EatsPanama

> Independent restaurant discovery and dining coverage for Panama City, in English and Spanish. A neighborhood-by-neighborhood directory of ~1,300 restaurants plus editorial "where to eat" guides. Trust rule: no restaurant can pay for rankings or reviews, and there are no star ratings. Facts (cuisine, price, hours, location) come from public sources and each venue's own channels.

## Guides
- [Where to Eat Brunch in Panama City](https://eatspanama.com/guides/best-brunch-panama-city/): the brunch shortlist, checked against opening hours.
- [Specialty Coffee in Panama City: Where to Drink It](https://eatspanama.com/guides/best-coffee-panama-city/): the best specialty coffee rooms.
- [Where to Have Dinner in Casco Viejo](https://eatspanama.com/guides/best-dinners-casco-viejo/): dinner spots in the old town.
- [All guides](https://eatspanama.com/guides/)

## Browse the directory
- [Where to eat in Panama City](https://eatspanama.com/panama-city/): the full directory, by neighborhood.
- [By cuisine](https://eatspanama.com/panama-city/cuisine/): Italian, Japanese, Panamanian, and more.
- [By occasion ("good for")](https://eatspanama.com/panama-city/good-for/): rooftop, date night, brunch, dog-friendly, and more.

## About
- [How EatsPanama works](https://eatspanama.com/how-we-review/): what a listing is, how facts are sourced, and why nothing is for sale.
- [Contact](https://eatspanama.com/contact/): corrections, press, and restaurant listing claims.
